protocol.basis: All six groove vertices and both sloping facets; both pure L and S; encounter before or after the image pixel; optional ID reflection before or after the geometry encounter; other branch direct or one ID reflection. No feature or setting chosen from LOF scores.
protocol.scope: Same-mode specular elastic reflection coefficients. Unit corner coefficient: timing-only diffraction hypothesis without a calibrated wedge amplitude/phase. Converted corner modes and Rayleigh-to-bulk diffraction are outside scope.
protocol.protocol: Common known-response weighting at 0.1 mm, plus a timing-mean sensitivity at 0.2 mm for every new path. Three matched signal cases for every job. Six conventional controls in both processing modes at 0.1 mm.
protocol.inference: Exploratory test on previously seen data, not blind validation. Report coverage and pristine controls with contrast. The strongest result across 192 new paths is descriptive, not a tuned recommendation.

catalogue.scope: Experimental same-mode L/S paths: one exposed bevel reflection or one fixed groove-corner timing encounter; optional backwall before or after it. Corner diffraction amplitude/phase is not modelled.
